text:
deploy-bot: Deploy v1.43.0 -> eu-west-1 started. Running post-deploy smoke: shadow/webhook-probe x3. Results will follow. (ETA ~2m)

Samir K.: seeing 2/3 timeouts on shadow probe, pods webhook-proxy-5 and webhook-proxy-7 returning timeouts/504s. Noticed p95 jump for short-token requests.

Maria L.: can you paste the probe logs?

deploy-bot: Probe log excerpt:
```
ERROR: Probe /shadow/webhook timed out after 30s
caused by: tls handshake error: remote error: tls: handshake failure
pod: webhook-proxy-5
stack: net/http: TLS handshake timeout
```

Jessie P.: that's our partner-facing webhook path. if shadow probes failing we should not keep rolling eu-west. recommend pin/rollback for eu-west only. :warning:

Oliver H.: can we shadow to the legacy GW pool (gw-legacy) temporarily while we diagnose? That would stop partner traffic hitting the new path.

Kai (oncall): if we can't get a config fix in <15m, rollback/pin eu-west. prefer pin to stable v1.42.3 so we don't clobber global rollout state.

Samir K.: quick check command I ran: `kubectl -n prod get configmap webhook-config -o yaml | grep TLS` — new config lacks ALLOW_LEGACY_TLS=true that the previous release shipped with. suspect merge conflict dropped the flag.

Maria L.: confirming. new configmap data: `TLS_MIN_VERSION: "1.3"` and no ALLOW_LEGACY_TLS key. Some partner clients still use TLS1.2. I'll patch the configmap to re-enable legacy TLS acceptance for EU while we fix the merge.

Maria L.: patching now:
```
kubectl -n prod patch configmap webhook-config --type=json -p '[{"op":"add","path":"/data/ALLOW_LEGACY_TLS","value":"true"}]' && kubectl rollout restart deploy/webhook-proxy -n prod -l region=eu-west-1
```

deploy-bot: Re-running post-deploy smoke probes for shadow/webhook x3...

deploy-bot: Results: 3/3 PASS. p95 latency 180ms, no TLS handshake errors reported. (logs attached to release job 1845000000)

Jessie P.: good catch. I still want to be conservative — pin eu-west to v1.42.3 until we push the config change through CI and verify by a follow-up canary.

Oliver H.: I'll open the pin CR and hold the automated rolling restart for eu-west. Command I'll run: `releasectl pin --region eu-west-1 --service webhook-proxy --version v1.42.3 --reason "post-deploy TLS regressions"`

Samir K.: decision: Pin eu-west-1 to v1.42.3, unpause global rollout but exclude eu-west for 30m. We will merge the config change in master, run a fresh canary, then unpin if green. :thumbsup:

Kai (oncall): noted. I'll create an incident note and monitor metrics for 1h. Move to postmortems if this reoccurs.

Maria L.: will create PR to restore ALLOW_LEGACY_TLS flag in config repo and add a unit test to prevent regressions.

Jessie P.: update release notes: "eu-west rollout paused/pinned due to TLS handshake regressions; fix merged to be canaried."

deploy-bot: Rollout controller: eu-west-1 excluded from v1.43.0, pin applied. :white_check_mark:

Samir K.: closing thread — action items: PR from Maria, pin CR from Oliver, monitor by Kai. Reopen if probes fail.
